name: ZPM
desc:
Special hullmod that can be installed only when ZPM is present in inventory. Installation removes all installed Asgard hullmods. 
Your fleet currently requires %s ZPMs to be operational, you have %s ZPMs in inventory.
If your number of ZPMs in inventory falls under %s, all ships loose equiped ZPM hullmods, connected boosts and will have to be re-equiped with ZPM hullmod again.

name: ZPM powered shields
desc: ZPM overcharges shield systems to increased durability, arc and unfold speed.

name: ZPM powered engines
desc: ZPM overcharges drive systems to increased speeds in hyperspace, star systems and battle.

name: ZPM powered beam weapons
desc: ZPM overcharges beam weapon systems to increased to increased damage, range and decreased flux cost.

name: ZPM flux system bypass
desc: ZPM supplements ship life support systems to decrease supply consumption and bypasses flux regulators to directly supply ship energy needs. However heat buildup requires ship to use flux system to store and vent massive ammounts of waste heat ZPM produces in shield and weapon systems.
